info.title: MACKORN Hydraulic Cone Crusher API
info.description: Query MACKORN (Shanghai Mackorn Minerals) hydraulic cone crusher models, capacity tables, model recommendation by target t/h, material library and liner life. All numbers come from MACKORN vendor tables (source level S1). Every response carries assumptions[] and warnings[] which MUST be relayed to the user.

get.summary: 列出 MACKORN 全部液压圆锥破机型与腔型
get.description: List all MACKORN hydraulic cone crusher models with their max feed size, CSS range, motor power, weight and capacity. Use this when the user asks "what models do you have" / "你们有什么型号" / wants an overview before choosing.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Fixed action for this tool. Must be "catalog".

200.description: JSON string containing the query result

response.description: JSON-encoded string of { result, assumptions, warnings, source }

get.summary: 查某机型的完整腔型×CSS 产能表
get.description: Get the full cavity-by-CSS capacity table for one MACKORN model (e.g. NH400). Returns css_list and cavity_rows where each row has cavity code, max feed size and a [min,max] tph pair per CSS. Use this when the user names a specific model and asks for its specifications.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Fixed action for this tool. Must be "specs".

200.description: JSON string containing the query result

response.description: JSON-encoded string of { result, assumptions, warnings, source }

get.summary: 查某机型+CSS+腔型的精确产能区间
get.description: Query the exact capacity range (t/h) for one MACKORN model at a given closed-side-setting (CSS) and optionally a cavity code. Returns min/max tph per cavity. If the CSS is not in the vendor table, returns available CSS list instead of interpolating. Use this when the user gives model + CSS and asks "how many tonnes per hour".

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Fixed action for this tool. Must be "capacity".

parameters.name: css
parameters.description: Closed side setting in mm. Must be one of the model css_list values.

parameters.name: cavity
parameters.description: Optional cavity code: EC/C/MC/M/MF/F/EF/EFX/EEF. Omit to get all cavities.

200.description: JSON string containing the query result

response.description: JSON-encoded string of { result, assumptions, warnings, source }

get.summary: 按目标产能推荐机型档位
get.description: Recommend MACKORN model tier(s) for a target capacity in t/h. Returns the smallest tier whose tphMax covers the request, with model options and motor power. If the target exceeds the largest single unit, returns EXCEEDS_SINGLE_UNIT instead of a wrong answer. Use this when the user says "I need 500 tonnes per hour, which model".

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Fixed action for this tool. Must be "recommend".

parameters.name: tph
parameters.description: Required capacity in tonnes per hour (t/h).

200.description: JSON string containing the query result

response.description: JSON-encoded string of { result, assumptions, warnings, source }

get.summary: 查矿石物料库（硬度/磨蚀性参考）
get.description: Look up MACKORN material library for ore/rock properties (hardness, abrasiveness, bond work index reference). Optional keyword filter, e.g. 花岗岩 / granite / 玄武岩 / 铁矿. Use this when the user mentions a specific ore type and you need to know how it affects crusher selection.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Fixed action for this tool. Must be "materials".

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional keyword, e.g. '花岗岩', 'granite', 'iron ore'. Omit to list the library.

200.description: JSON string containing the query result

response.description: JSON-encoded string of { result, assumptions, warnings, source }

get.description: Get liner (wear part) life reference for MACKORN cone crushers, optionally per model. Use this when the user asks about wear parts, liner replacement interval, or operating cost.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Fixed action for this tool. Must be "liner".

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional model code. Omit to return the whole table.

200.description: JSON string containing the query result

response.description: JSON-encoded string of { result, assumptions, warnings, source }
